decision.title: Compiling XSLT and Schematron: the component graph, value templates, the Schematron front end (packet )
decision.summary: XSLT compiles find components through sorted indexes and node maps, value templates without braces skip the parser, and the Schematron builder parses each synthesized text once through a hash table.

body.p: , after , , , and (its proposal "XSLT compile costs that grow with the square of a stylesheet"). No public header changed; the IR after the passes is the same, and compiled Schematron gives the same findings.

item.p: Whom it serves: every compile of a large stylesheet and every Schematron compile, first EN 16931's (900 KB of pre-compiled XSLT; the .sch sources compiled by sxml validate --schematron). Pays: three sorted indexes made once per lowering, a node map for the templates and the globals, a hash table of parsed texts per Schematron compile; no new mechanism (sorting is src/sort_internal.h's).

Profile (callgrind, release, at 3919bc7ce): the invoice transform 2.077 x 10^9 instructions, value templates 6.3 % (each attribute of a literal result element parsed, braces or not); the invoice validate --schematron 3.366, of which the Schematron compile 2.138: building the AST 1.102 (XPath parses of the schema's expressions 0.391; of synthesized texts 0.627: 4,567 tree-sitter parses of a dozen texts such as "$Q{urn:sxml:schematron}subject", one set per assertion), reading 0.355 (5.4.11's check that parameter names are distinct compared each of a pattern instance's 780 parameters with every earlier one: 0.185; the included documents' XML 0.138), the XSLT compile 0.681. The growth series of (regenerated: N blocks of 8 template rules with 3 Schematron-style assertions, 8 globals, a function and a named template; and 2 blocks whose templates hold 6 to 384 assertions) grew x 2.46 per doubling at N = 256: a component found by name walked all declarations (add_named_edges, 4.17 at N = 256) or its package's instances (find_instance under sxml_xslt_package_bind, 1.17); an expression's owning global walked the globals, a variable reference the declaration view (1.17 with the rest of the globals' ordering), find_template_entry the templates (0.20), check_conflicts every pair of a package's instances.

Indexes made by sorting, searched by binary search, each giving what the walk gave, in its order: the component graph's named declarations by kind, name and declaration order (the edges in declaration order); the package table's instances by package, kind, name and index (find_instance chooses the first of the highest precedence whose arity range fits, as before); the names of each declaration view (one index per view, shared by the static contexts that have it) for the first declaration of a name; for check_conflicts, a package's instances by kind and name, the first pair in index order reported. Node maps: AST node to global (the owner of an expression), AST node to template entry. A package that accepts no mode skips XTSE3050's search of rules.

A value template without "{" or "}" is its text (XSLT 4.0, 5.6.1): built directly as the AST the parser made: the XPATH root, the STRING_TEMPLATE body, one fixed part (none for an empty text), every span the whole text at 1:1, the parser's capacities. A text the fixed part scanner rejects (NUL, U+FFFE, U+FFFF, invalid UTF-8) or a depth limit below 3 goes to the parser.

The Schematron builder parses each synthesized text once: a hash table (FNV-1a, open addressing) keeps the AST of each fixed text by value kind and text, and each use takes a copy, node for node and the text store byte for byte, what the front end would build; the spans are placed as before. 5.4.11's distinct names: the parameters sorted by name and position, a name equal to the one before it repeated, reported in parameter order as before.

Measured, instructions x 10^9 (callgrind, release; base 3919bc7ce and each step built alike from snapshots): invoice transform 2.077 to 2.070 (indexes) to 1.958 (value templates; -5.7 % in all); invoice validate 3.366 to 3.358 to 3.358 to 2.633 (Schematron; -21.8 %), its compile 2.138 to 1.405 (build 1.102 to 0.556, read 0.355 to 0.176); growth N = 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256: 0.397, 0.769, 1.556, 3.290, 7.392, 18.165 to 0.371, 0.706, 1.380, 2.731, 5.460, 11.039 (each doubling x 1.90 to 2.02, was x 1.94 to 2.46); at N = 256 add_named_edges 4.173 to 0.009, sxml_xslt_package_bind 1.167 to 0.015, ordering the globals 5.343 to 0.101 (with add_named_edges), the value template builder 0.779 to 0.057; templates of 6, 24, 96, 384 assertions 0.197, 0.663, 2.527, 9.982 to 0.186, 0.621, 2.358, 9.304; xmark-all 8.638 to 8.638 (output equal). Processor seconds (fastest of 15, interleaved, a shared machine): invoice transform 0.274 to 0.263, validate 0.442 to 0.380; fastest of 5: N = 128 0.89 to 0.74, N = 256 2.39 to 1.62, 384 assertions 1.39 to 1.29; the XT40 run (its 414,483 compiles and the transforms) 354.0 to 353.9 (its stylesheets are small).

Same result: the IR text form after the passes (dumped by a scratch-only hook in sxml_ir_run_passes, as in ) is byte-identical on EN16931-UBL-validation.xslt (141 MB of text), on the growth stylesheets, and on all 414,470 units the XT40 suite compiles (an FNV-1a hash and length per unit, in order). Schematron: sxml validate --format=json over EN 16931's 1,131 UBL unit tests and 19 examples gives byte-identical output (6.3 MB, every finding with its location); 7.30's suite through sxml-schematron-test 463 of 463 applicable cases, 3 deviations, 43 implementation-defined, 5 not applicable, as before; EN 16931 UBL 1,133 of 1,133 checks from the .sch sources. Conformance setup: base and change built alike (preset , snapshots of 3919bc7ce and of the change), run one after the other on the same machine with TZ, LANG and LC_ALL unset, from each snapshot's root: sxml-qt4 run --spec=XP40 --format=json, sxml-qt4 run --spec=XQ40 --format=json, sxml-xslt-test run --format=json (default catalogs, no test list). XP40 32,785, XQ40 46,114 and XT40 12,185 passed in both: 0 outcomes differ, case by case. debug-gcc: the whole suite passes (459 tests; kotlin/jvm and swift/linux skipped); clang-tidy clean on the changed files; tools/check-call-cycles.py finds no cycle ().
Deviation: src/xslt_value_template.c (the packet's mechanism names it; its Owns list does not) is changed; no other packet owns it.

Left (see "## Proposed"): at N = 256 the costs that still grow with the square of the stylesheet are about 0.29 x 10^9 of 11.04: XSLT streamability's is_streamable_mode (src/xslt_streamability.c) walks the declarations for each template rule (0.18); the XPath lowerer's look_up_variable (src/xpath_lower.c) walks the declaration view for each variable reference (0.05); the duplicate searches as declarations are added (add_own_instances, find_global, 0.05). In the Schematron compile the XPath front end on the schema's own expressions (0.37) and the entry numbers, one parse each (0.06, 1,086 texts), remain; the validation of the compiled schema (1.21) costs twice what the pre-compiled XSLT's transform (0.55) does on the same invoice, an evaluation cost outside this packet.
